title: Prove Dashboard machine observations in Node Vitest

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The maintained Vitest case caught a missed linked-worktree branch advance.

- Story `SEED-413#machine-observation-via-vitest`, selected revision `34bf89399ff58158c8ee735f10a8822068c6ca53`, plan 866 slice 1. A linked worktree commit advances its branch and changes the checkout’s Git identity after the trust window.
- The single scratch fault at [gitFilesIdentity.ts:104](dashboard/server/gitFilesIdentity.ts#L104) substituted a constant for the linked branch ref’s file identity. Its symbolic HEAD and all other identity inputs still flowed through the production code.
- An independent Git fixture advanced `refs/heads/probe` from `1a569f43a4b86d8bfddadb6644eead2f11e51835` to `8db99e442727df715e4e45d53ce5a103b1b45c6a`. The linked HEAD still named that ref, both sampled identities were defined and equal, and the controlled clock was two seconds ahead. The independent observation established the missed change on the faulted path.
- The maintained case [advancing a worktree branch changes the checkout’s Git identity](dashboard/backend-tests/observation/git-files-identity.spec.ts#L84) passed at baseline. With the fault, its `expect(await settledIdentity(checkout)).not.toBe(held)` assertion failed on equal identities. After restoration, the source matched its backup byte for byte, Git status matched its clean baseline, and the same case passed. Each run selected exactly one case, with ten skipped. The scratch worktree was removed.
- Command for all three runs: `caffeinate -s -i node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config dashboard/backend.vitest.config.mts dashboard/backend-tests/observation/git-files-identity.spec.ts --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=verbose -t 'advancing a worktree branch'`.

**Next proof action.** Retain the current case for this branch-advance path.

- **Test runtime.** Measured Vitest durations were 3.22 s at baseline, 0.421 s with the fault, and 0.441 s after restoration. The selected case took 64 ms, 62 ms, and 66 ms respectively.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable in minutes. No human timing was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable in minutes. The recorded interval includes setup and tool waits and does not isolate active agent effort.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 90600 ms (measured), from 1795859458716 to 1795859549316 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: `34bf89399ff58158c8ee735f10a8822068c6ca53` — Caught — retain the maintained case, no follow-up.
